en: Vintage sepia postcard with three photographs showing traditional rural life and people in folk costumes. The large right-hand image depicts a couple in traditional Greek dress standing in a doorway, apparently engaged or being married. Two smaller images on the left show villagers: one outside a stone house, another inside a room with a loom or weaving apparatus. On the right side of the postcard there is printed French text indicating Greece, the Peloponnese region, and the town of Andritsaina.
